style_prefix: Hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, cold charcoal stone and iron against warm furnace-amber light, restrained supernatural ambiguity, practical worn materials, abstract unlettered record marks, dry human intimacy under institutional pressure.

prompts.prompt: Wide compact rectangular fortress-hostel copy room: east iron-strapped door glowing orange from a furnace court, west corridor toward sleeping rooms and steam pots, north felt curtain over an ash-service stair and caged chute, south heat-pipe bench and aid cupboard, central scarred table under two oil lamps with parchment, grain jar, wool wrap, sealed roll, and five adult workers at separate stations.

Medium view across a warm stone copy table: lean braided memory keeper writes; tall older white-head-wrapped mortuary witness guards a sealed dark roll; broad scar-faced claimant listens from a heated bench; stocky key-looped store steward counts grain and bedding; wiry soot-head-clothed ash porter knots a corded packet by the stair curtain.

High three-quarter view of four conspiracy preparations in one compact copy room: adverse-margin parchment and ink at central table, opened aid cupboard with grain and wool on south wall, corded packet by north ash stair, household witness copy held at heated bench; east court door and west hostel corridor clearly visible.

Stateful workroom after preparation: five workers returned to fixed stations around central table, sealed answer roll, household copy, aid shelf, and porter packet; one branch result visibly changed as dense four-part margin, broken grain seal and entered support, soot-marked checked stair, or public copy held apart from closed membership list.

Power-changing entrance through east furnace door: compact middle-aged registrar with cropped gray hair, charcoal wool, copper seal chain, and iron-bound case steps into warm stone copy room; two tablet-carrying clerks wait in orange threshold light while five hostel workers turn from table, roll, bench, cupboard, and stair.

Medium confrontation across central table: registrar beside open iron-bound branch case and certified extract; braided memory keeper opposite with closed five-name list; scar-faced claimant holding household copy; soot-marked porter beside north curtain with corded packet; mortuary roll and aid cupboard remain in separate background custody.

Wide copy room under registry pressure: open iron case narrows east courtward path, two clerks align at doorway, west hostel corridor and north ash stair remain visible; five separate custody anchors surround the table—membership page, sealed roll, household copy, opened aid account, route packet.

Whole compact room at first furnace horn: orange light rises through caged ash chute, oil flames lean, soot lifts from north stair; memory keeper and registrar face each other across table while mortuary witness grips sealed roll, claimant holds household copy, store steward guards aid, porter stands on outside route.

Public disclosure aftermath: braided memory keeper reads five names from open list under two lamps; copper-chained registrar and threshold clerks copy them; five members remain visibly anchored to separate roll, household page, aid account, and stair packet, exposure creating named danger while material leverage persists.

Distributed fallback across three room routes: tall mortuary witness carries sealed roll east toward furnace court; broad claimant holds household copy separately; stocky store steward keeps opened food and wool at south cupboard; wiry porter descends north stair with packet; memory keeper stays at table and registrar occupies only east edge.

Public claimant at east threshold: broad older scar-faced laborer stands alone in orange furnace light with one folded household copy before registrar's open case; several paces behind in amber workroom, memory keeper, mortuary witness, store steward, and ash porter remain beside their separate records, food, and road.

North ash-service stair refuge: wiry porter in soot-gray headcloth leads broad older claimant down iron-edged steps beside caged ash chute; claimant carries folded household record, grain jar, and thick wool wrap; landing visibly divides lower toward furnace court and level toward an outer shrine road while registrar remains distant above by east door.
